ab00003 3.paragraph: One church family, worshipping in Cantonese, English and Mandarin.

ab00014 23.paragraph: Our church began in 1977 with Cantonese worship. As Mandarin and English ministries grew, we became a church family worshipping in three languages.

ab0001f 37.paragraph: Our church was founded in 1977 with worship in Cantonese. During the 1980s, as the number of Mandarin-speaking immigrants in Los Angeles grew rapidly, the church saw the need to share the gospel and provide a spiritual home for new arrivals. Mandarin worship began in 1988. English worship was added in 1991, and the church continues to worship in all three languages.

ab00029 48.title:
Knowing God is our foundation.
Glorifying God is our goal.

ab0002a 49.paragraph: Through worship, fellowship, discipleship, ministry, and evangelism, we seek to know God, and make His name known.

ab00036 62.paragraph: Originally from Hong Kong, Pastor Caleb studied at Fuller Theological Seminary and Claremont Graduate University and now serves as our senior pastor.

ab00039 68.paragraph: Pastor Caleb is from Hong Kong. After being called to ministry, he studied theology at Fuller Theological Seminary and pursued doctoral studies in theology and philosophy of religion at Claremont Graduate University. He has continued serving and shepherding this church and is its senior pastor.

bc00038 100.paragraph: God is the Creator and Ruler of the universe. He exists eternally as three persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. These three are equal and are one God.

bc0003d 112.paragraph: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and is equal with the Father. Jesus lived a sinless life on earth and offered Himself as the perfect sacrifice, dying on the cross for all humanity. He rose from the dead after three days, demonstrating His power over sin and death. He ascended to heavenly glory and will return to earth as King of kings and Lord of lords.

bc00040 114.paragraph: Matthew 1:22-23; Isaiah 9:6; John 1:1-5, 14:10-30; Hebrews 4:14,15; 1 Corinthians 15:3-4; Romans 1:3-4; Acts 1:9-11; 1 Timothy 6:14; Titus 2:13

bc00042 124.paragraph: The Holy Spirit is equal with the Father and the Son. He is present in the world to help people know Christ, and He lives in every Christian from the moment of salvation. He gives believers power for daily living, understanding of spiritual truth and guidance for the way ahead. He gives spiritual gifts to every believer. As Christians, we seek daily to live under the Holy Spirit’s direction.

bc00045 126.paragraph: 2 Corinthians 3:17; John 16:7-13, 14:16-17; Acts 1:8; 1 Corinthians 2:12; 3:16 Ephesians 1:13,5:18; Galatians 5:25

bc00047 136.paragraph: The Bible is God’s Word to us, written by people under the supernatural guidance of the Holy Spirit. It is the highest authority for Christian faith and life.

bc0004c 148.paragraph: Human beings were created in God’s spiritual image, reflecting His character. Humanity is the pinnacle of God’s creation. Although every person has the potential for good, our sinful attitudes separate us from God and bring many problems into our lives.

bc00051 160.paragraph: Salvation is God’s free gift, which we must receive. We can never atone for our sins through good works or self-improvement. Only through Jesus Christ and God’s forgiveness can we be delivered from the penalty of sin. We are saved when we turn in faith to Jesus from a self-centred life lived in our own strength. Eternal life begins when we receive the life of Jesus Christ by faith.

bc00056 172.paragraph: Because God gives us eternal life through Jesus Christ, true believers have eternal assurance of salvation. Salvation comes through God’s power and grace, not through a Christian’s own efforts. His preserving power and grace give us this lasting assurance. Believers also have a responsibility to continue trusting God and living in His care.

bc00059 174.paragraph: John 10:29; 2 Timothy 1:12; Hebrews 7:25, 10:10,14; 1 Peter 1:3-5; Hebrews 6:4-8; Hebrews 10:26-27; John 15:6

bc0005b 184.paragraph: People were created to exist forever. We will either be eternally separated from God because of sin, or live eternally with Him through forgiveness and salvation. Eternal separation from God is hell; eternal life is being with God forever.
